 Denzel Boston (toe) hopeful to practice Thursday 
 by Ari Koslow | Browns Correspondent | Thu, Nov 12th 2026, 12:47pm EST 
 Denzel Boston told reporters he's hopeful to return to practice on Thursday. ( Zac Jackson on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Boston missed practice on Wednesday to start the week due to a toe injury. “Definitely feel better. Trending up," he said. 
 Denzel Boston said he’s hoping and “working” to be back to practice today after missing Wednesday with a toe injury. 
“Definitely feel better. Trending up.”
— Zac Jackson (@AkronJackson) November 12, 2026
